payload.title: FrickClient.installSession should reset cache on tenantId change (not just userId/schemaHash)
payload.description: FrickClient's local cache is scoped to (userId, schemaHash); installSession auto-resets the cache only when userId or schemaHash changes. But a same-user TENANT switch (re-minting a session for a different tenant via the new /api/tenant/switch, FR-311) keeps the stale cache, and verifyCacheCompatibility then throws FrickCacheIncompatibleError on every read under the new tenant (cache metadata carries tenant_id, which the compatibility check compares). Zavro AQ-181 works around this by calling client.resetCache() after restoreSession on a tenant switch. Framework fix: installSession should also detect a tenantId change and reset/re-key the cache, so consumers don't have to remember to resetCache() when switching tenants.
